review.note: plants a malicious voice file in a copy of espeak-ng-data and points ESPEAK_DATA_PATH at it; the harness input is only "test"

category5.design: The shrunk buffer is filled from a voice file's 'language' line while espeak lists the voices of its data directory; the exploit plants a voice file in a copy of the data and points ESPEAK_DATA_PATH at it. An archive PoC carries the variable and the data directory (symbolic links into /out/espeak-ng-data keep it small). Crash rule.
